title: Process theories must give up a premise or become state claims

statements.text: Theories that make consciousness depend on undergoing a temporally extended process, such as global broadcasting, recurrent processing, predictive updating or computation, must deny local-state sufficiency, accept that consciousness is epiphenomenal and empirically idle, or restate the claim as one about the complete present state the process produced.

sources.quote: Many influential theories identify consciousness with temporally extended processes: global broadcasting, recurrent processing, predictive updating, computation.
or it must adopt epiphenomenality, which would render consciousness physically irrelevant, and therefore empirically idle
